title: Changing the ad background color reduced revenue

change.variant: Treatment background color; exact color not specified in the text.

quote: the Treatment color caused a 12% decline in revenue (an annual loss of over $150M if this change were made).
notes: Over 10M users. Clicks shifted away from ads; abandonment not significantly changed (p=0.83). That p-value does not describe revenue. Full text is also available in the author-hosted PDF at https://exp-platform.com/Documents/2014%20experimentersRulesOfThumb.pdf. The supporting quote and result were checked against that PDF; the equivalent ACM publisher full-text page returned HTTP 403 in Chromium.
